'''Raktha Empor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Empor provided the knowledge of synthweaving to others.
